exposure: Level of neonatal care (Level IV vs. Level III NICU)
cohort: 210 extremely low birth weight infants (birth weight <1,000 g) admitted to two level IV and two level III neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) in Thailand.
finding: While level IV NICUs conducted more blood tests, there was no significant difference in cumulative phlebotomy loss or the number of transfusions between level IV and level III NICUs.
